sourceQuestion: For each existing horizon and starting label, ask for at least half the original windows rounded up. Retain only the individual post-start labels inspected by that answer.
targetQuestions: Shift the origin of the nonoverlapping windows by one base sample or by half a horizon. Recompute the starting-label denominator. Ask every integer threshold from one through that denominator, each starting with only the source question's inspected labels.

policies.fresh: Run the endpoint-first early-stopping scan with no prior sample observations.
policies.memoized: Keep the same scan order and consult the source observations at each label lookup.
policies.indexed: Use the source observations to certify an away sample within a new window or verify that its entire post-start interval is covered. Scan only the remaining uncertainty with the same memoized reader.

controls: Compare all decisions to independently counted events in the shifted windows. Check every witness and complete absence. Refuse a sample cache from another immutable trace. Count new post-start label reads, logical probes, and seed-window checks separately.
